import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Wait more
import time
time.sleep(10)
# Check status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 status 2>&1")
print("Status:", stdout.read().decode())
# Try again
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s http://localhost:3000/health 2>&1")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode()[:200])
client.close()
EOF
